pagedata.pyBrowseSQL: SELECT sum((PREMI * CO_SHARE * PLUS_MINUS * EXCHANGE) + (DISC * CO_SHARE * PLUS_MINUS * EXCHANGE * -1) + (DISC2 * CO_SHARE * PLUS_MINUS * EXCHANGE * -1) + (COMM * CO_SHARE * PLUS_MINUS * EXCHANGE * -1) + (PPN * CO_SHARE * EXCHANGE * -1) + (OC * CO_SHARE * PLUS_MINUS * EXCHANGE * -1)) AS "LSC_ID" FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(MDS.MDS_TGL_PROD) AS TGL_PROD, MDS.LBU_ID AS LBU_ID, DATAMINING.GET_CABANG@simasnet(MDS.LDC_ID, MDS.LMO_ID) AS LDC_ID, MDS.LJP_ID AS LJP_ID, MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS AS NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE AS PROD_KE, DECODE( DECODE( MDS.MDS_JN_COAS, '2', COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 0 ), '0', DECODE( MDS.MDS_JN_COAS, '0', 1, REINSURANCE.GET_PCT_ASM_COAS@simasnet(MDS.MSP_NO_SPAK, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE) ), 1 ) AS CO_SHARE, CASE WHEN MDS.LJP_ID IN ('4', '5') THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS PLUS_MINUS, DECODE( DECODE( MDS.MDS_JN_COAS, '2', COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 0 ), '0', NVL(MDS.MDS_SUM_TSI, 0), CASE WHEN MDS.LJP_ID IN ('4', '5') THEN TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'a' ) + 1, INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'b' ) - INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'a' ) - 1 ) ) * -1 ELSE TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'a' ) + 1, INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'b' ) - INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'a' ) - 1 ) ) * 1 END ) AS TSI, DECODE( DECODE( MDS.MDS_JN_COAS, CASE WHEN MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS IN ( SELECT NO_POLIS FROM COLLECTION.T_ADJUSTMENT_COAS@simasnet ) THEN '1' ELSE '2' END, COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 0 ), '0', NVL(MDS.MDS_SUM_PREMI, 0), CASE WHEN MDS.LJP_ID IN ('4', '5') THEN TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'b' ) + 1, INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'c' ) - INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'b' ) - 1 ) ) * -1 ELSE TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'b' ) + 1, INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'c' ) - INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'b' ) - 1 ) ) * 1 END ) AS PREMI, DECODE( DECODE( MDS.MDS_JN_COAS, '2', COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 0 ), '0', NVL(MDS.MDS_DISC, 0), CASE WHEN MDS.LJP_ID IN ('4', '5') THEN TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'c' ) + 1, INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'd' ) - INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'c' ) - 1 ) ) * -1 ELSE TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'c' ) + 1, INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'd' ) - INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'c' ) - 1 ) ) * 1 END ) AS DISC, DECODE( DECODE( MDS.MDS_JN_COAS, '2', COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 0 ), '0', NVL(MDS.MDS_DISC2, 0), CASE WHEN MDS.LJP_ID IN ('4', '5') THEN TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'd' ) + 1, INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'e' ) - INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'd' ) - 1 ) ) * -1 ELSE TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'd' ) + 1, INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'e' ) - INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'd' ) - 1 ) ) * 1 END ) AS DISC2, DECODE( DECODE( MDS.MDS_JN_COAS, CASE WHEN MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS IN ( SELECT NO_POLIS FROM COLLECTION.T_ADJUSTMENT_COAS@simasnet ) THEN '1' ELSE '2' END, COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 0 ), '0', NVL(MDS.MDS_COMM, 0), CASE WHEN MDS.LJP_ID IN ('4', '5') THEN TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'f' ) + 1, INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'g' ) - INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'f' ) - 1 ) ) * -1 ELSE TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'f' ) + 1, INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'g' ) - INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'f' ) - 1 ) ) * 1 END ) + CASE WHEN MDS.LBU_ID IN ('B2', 'B3', 'B4', 'B5', 'B6', 'B7') THEN MDS.MDS_SUM_PREMI * NVL( ( SELECT PCT_KOMISI_FAC_IN FROM ANEKA.T_POLIS_ANEKA@simasnet TPA WHERE TPA.NO_SPPA = MDS.MSP_NO_SPAK AND TPA.PROD_ID = MDS.MDS_PROD_KE ), 0 ) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN MDS.LBU_ID IN ( SELECT LB.LBU_ID FROM LST_BUSINESS@simasnet LB WHERE LB.LGB_ID IN ('01') ) THEN MDS.MDS_SUM_PREMI * NVL( ( SELECT TFAC.RI_COMM / 100 FROM FIRE.T_FACIN@simasnet TFAC WHERE TFAC.TFIN_SPPA_NO = MDS.MSP_NO_SPAK AND TO_CHAR(TFAC.PROFILE_NO, '00009') = TO_CHAR(MDS.MDS_PROD_KE, '00009') ), 0 ) ELSE 0 END AS COMM, DECODE( DECODE( MDS.MDS_JN_COAS, '2', COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 0 ), '0', NVL(MDS.MDS_OC, 0), CASE WHEN MDS.LJP_ID IN ('4', '5') THEN TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'e' ) + 1, INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'f' ) - INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'e' ) - 1 ) ) * -1 ELSE TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'e' ) + 1, INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'f' ) - INSTR( COLLECTION.GET_COAS_ENDORS_SHARE@simasnet(MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS, MDS.MDS_PROD_KE), 'e' ) - 1 ) ) * 1 END ) AS OC, CASE WHEN TRUNC(MDS.MDS_TGL_PROD) >= TO_DATE('01/08/2019', 'DD/MM/RRRR') THEN NVL( ( SELECT SUM(PAYCOC_PPN) FROM MST_PAY_COC@simasnet B, MST_COMM@simasnet C WHERE B.COMMKWI_ID = C.COMMKWI_ID AND C.MSP_NO_SPAK = MDS.MSP_NO_SPAK AND C.MDS_PROD_KE = MDS.MDS_PROD_KE AND PTYPE_JN = '1' ), 0 ) + NVL( ( SELECT SUM(CDN_VAL_PPN) FROM MST_CDNOTE@simasnet B WHERE B.MSP_NO_SPAK = MDS.MSP_NO_SPAK AND B.MDS_PROD_KE = MDS.MDS_PROD_KE AND LDB_ID = '3' ), 0 ) ELSE 0 END AS PPN, MDS.LKU_ID, DATAMINING.GET_KURS_STANDARD@simasnet(MDS.LKU_ID, TRUNC(MDS.MDS_TGL_PROD)) AS EXCHANGE FROM COLLECTION.MST_SALES@simasnet S JOIN COLLECTION.MST_DET_SALES@simasnet MDS ON S.MSP_NO_SPAK = MDS.MSP_NO_SPAK WHERE MDS.MDS_NO_POLIS in (select nopolis from pooldata.t_general gl where GL.BUSINESSCODE={TempServices.CaseIDCN} and SOBLEADER2 in (select ID from pooldata.agent where leader2 = (select sobleader2 from pooldata.t_general where nopolis={TempServices.CabId} and rownum='1'))) )
